DrawerRoot.description: Holds the drawer's open state and its swipe, and shares them with the parts inside it. It is a DialogRoot underneath.

props.open: Whether the drawer is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the drawer.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the drawer is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called when a part, Escape, a press outside or a swipe asks to open or close the drawer. A controlled drawer changes only when `open` does. It is called in a change of its own, after the drawer's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the drawer.
props.swipeDirection: The edge the drawer is swiped out through: `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"` or `"right"`.
props.swipeThreshold: How far a swipe must travel to close the drawer, in pixels. When it isn't given, half the drawer's size along `swipeDirection`. A fast flick closes it whatever the distance.
props.modal: Whether the drawer is opened with `showModal()`: in the top layer, with a backdrop, the page behind it inert and its scroll locked. As DialogRoot's.
props.dismissible: Whether Escape and a press outside close the drawer. With `false` only its own buttons and a swipe do.
props.disablePointerDismissal: Whether a press outside is ignored. Escape and a swipe still close the drawer.

DrawerTrigger.description: The button that opens the drawer.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the drawer is open.

DrawerPopup.description: The `<dialog>` element, which follows the swipe. Place it against its edge in CSS and translate it by the movement variables. Its `::backdrop` inherits the variables.

dataAttributes.data-swipe-direction: The edge it is swiped out through: `up`, `down`, `left` or `right`.
dataAttributes.data-swiping: Present while the drawer is being dragged.
dataAttributes.data-swipe-dismiss: Present when the drawer was last closed by a swipe, until it opens again.
dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the drawer animates out. It stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

cssVariables.--drawer-swipe-movement-x: How far the drawer has been dragged horizontally, in pixels. `0px` at rest.
cssVariables.--drawer-swipe-movement-y: How far the drawer has been dragged vertically, in pixels. `0px` at rest.
cssVariables.--drawer-swipe-progress: The drag towards `swipeDirection` as a fraction of the drawer's size, from 0 to 1.

DrawerContent.description: Holds the drawer's content. A mouse press inside it selects text instead of starting a swipe; a touch still swipes.

dataAttributes.data-drawer-content: Always present. It marks the area where a mouse press doesn't start a swipe.

DrawerTitle.description: A heading that names the drawer. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

DrawerDescription.description: A paragraph that describes the drawer. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

DrawerClose.description: A button that closes the drawer.
